subject: Geo-residency snapshot inventory and erase playbook request

Subject: Request: residency snapshot + planned purge playbook

Hi Marcus,

We are preparing for a FinServe internal compliance review (scheduled week of Nov 13) and need a short audit packet showing how our Dedicated deployment is constrained to a single geography, as well as the deletion/wipe procedures you would run if we request tenant purge. Specifically we need:

- An inventory of current snapshots and backups that contain FinServe tenant data and the region(s) those copies live in.
- Confirmation that automated snapshots and s3-style backups for our dedicated instance do not replicate outside the pinned region unless explicitly enabled.
- Retention windows for snapshots vs backups, and the method used to purge (logical delete, physical overwrite, cryptographic erase).
- Evidence you can provide after a wipe (logs/artifacts) and approximate lead times for producing that evidence.

We are pinned to us-west-2 today; please treat this as time sensitive. Can you also attach any runbook that describes the tenant wipe flow and the kinds of artifacts you can supply (audit logs, snapshot deletion receipts, KMS key rotation logs, etc.)?

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Compliance
FinServe Inc.

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. I pulled a preliminary inventory and attached a short residency matrix (residency-matrix.pdf) that maps snapshots/backups to regions for your tenant. High level answers below; Dev is copied to confirm details and add technical notes.

- Region pin: Your Dedicated pool is pinned to us-west-2 and our control plane shows no active cross-region replication for tenant FS-7123.
- Snapshots/backups: Automated incremental snapshots are taken within us-west-2. Standard backup exports are stored in an encrypted bucket in the same region by default.
- Retention: default snapshot retention is 30 days; full backup retention is 90 days for the current config. Both are configurable per contract.
- Purge evidence: we can provide deletion receipts, audit logs showing API calls, and a signed attestation after a manual wipe.

I've asked Dev to provide the exact wipe steps and cryptographic/metadata erasure details below. Grace will coordinate scheduling the evidence call and the deliverables package.

Subject: Re: Request: residency snapshot + planned purge playbook — technical details

Hi Elena — following up with technical details for the items you asked about. Bullet answers for the audit packet; happy to expand on the call.

1) Cross-region replication
- By default, automated incremental snapshots and the platform-managed backups for Dedicated deployments are constrained to the pinned region (us-west-2 in your case).
- Cross-region replication is strictly opt-in and requires a configuration change plus an approval workflow; we do not enable it for tenants unless requested in writing.

2) Encryption / KMS
- Backups and snapshot artifacts are encrypted at-rest. For Dedicated customers we offer two options:
  a) Redwood-managed KMS: default for short-term onboarding.
  b) Customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key): can be configured for Dedicated pools — we will store encrypted backup keys and perform key-wrapping in-region.
- Key lifecycle events (create/rotate/revoke) are logged and can be exported as part of an evidence package. If you choose customer-managed KMS, the cloud provider's CloudTrail (or equivalent) provides the canonical key usage logs.

3) Retention and purge mechanics
- Snapshot retention: configured default 30 days (sliding window).
- Backup retention: configured default 90 days (full exports).
- Wipe/purge flow: we run a staged workflow — (a) revoke tenant credentials and quiesce requests; (b) delete live tenant objects; (c) delete snapshots and backup manifests; (d) cryptographically shred keys (if managed by Redwood) and remove metadata records from our control plane; (e) produce deletion receipts.
- Cryptographic erase: for Redwood-managed KMS keys we perform a key destruction and then purge associated metadata to render data unrecoverable. For customer-managed KMS we coordinate a proof of key revocation with your KMS admin.

4) Evidence and lead times
- We can produce: deletion receipts for API-driven object deletions, snapshot deletion logs, audit log excerpts (request ids/timestamps), and a signed attestation.
- Standard SLA to produce the evidence package: 5 business days after the purge completes. For expedited needs we can often compress to 48–72 hours with an agreed engagement and appropriate billing.

5) Backups in cold storage / long-term archives
- We will not move tenant data to a different region for archival without explicit consent. Long-term cold archives are a tenant-configurable feature and remain in-region by default.

If this looks good I will draft a short wipe-runbook doc (high-level steps + expected artifacts) and Marcus/Grace can share with you ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Dev Patel

Redwood Inference
